component.name: ShellMan
component.summary: Embedded terminal at the bottom of the window

description.p: ShellMan adds a real terminal at the bottom of Files windows. Press F4 to show it, give it the keyboard or hide it.

ul.li: The shell follows the folder displayed in the window
The selected files are available in the SEL variable
One terminal per tab, which can be split
Colors of your usual terminal, keyboard shortcuts that can be changed

screenshot.caption: Two terminals side by side under the files
